f.title: May use published NMPA/CDR technical guidelines for PV activities
f.statement: MAHs may refer to technical guidelines already issued by the NMPA and the Center for Drug Reevaluation (e.g. PSUR writing standard, E2C(R2) PBRER, guideline on collection and reporting of individual ADRs, instructions for the MAH ADR report form, guideline on PV delegation agreements) to carry out pharmacovigilance activities better.
f.clause: 一、后续会发布哪些指导原则 (Q1)
f.applicability: China; NMPA Center for Drug Reevaluation Q&A on the GVP (药物警戒质量管理规范)

rows.quote: 持有人可参照这些技术文件更好地开展药物警戒活动。

f.title: Ensure independence of the PV internal audit
f.statement: Internal audit may be performed independently by persons designated by the MAH or by external persons or experts; whichever approach is used, the MAH shall ensure the independence of the internal audit. Internal quality control activities organised by the pharmacovigilance department are not the internal audit required by the GVP.
f.clause: 二、持有人开展内审应注意哪些问题 (Q2)
f.applicability: China; NMPA Center for Drug Reevaluation Q&A on the GVP (药物警戒质量管理规范)

rows.quote: 内审工作可以由持有人指定人员独立进行，也可由外部人员或专家进行。持有人无论采取哪种组织方式，均应保证内审工作的独立性。药物警戒部门组织开展的内部质控活动不属于《规范》要求的内审。
rows.location: 二、持有人开展内审应注意哪些问题 (Q2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and any time limit; statement adds nothing. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应 = Mandatory, 可以/可 = Permitted, 需要关注 = Recommended).
rows.quote_en: Internal audit work may be carried out independently by personnel designated by the holder, or by external personnel or experts. Whichever organisational approach the holder adopts, it shall ensure the independence of the internal audit work. Internal quality control activities organised by the pharmacovigilance department do not count as the internal audit required by the GVP.

f.title: Base internal audits on risk, cover key PV activities and follow up findings
f.statement: Internal audits shall be risk-based and include key pharmacovigilance activities in scope. For issues found, the MAH should promptly identify causes, rectify and follow up, so as to continuously improve the effectiveness of the pharmacovigilance system.
f.clause: 二、持有人开展内审应注意哪些问题 (Q2)
f.applicability: China; NMPA Center for Drug Reevaluation Q&A on the GVP (药物警戒质量管理规范)
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.quote: 内审应当以防控风险为基础，将关键药物警戒活动纳入审查范围。针对内审发现的问题要及时查找原因、整改并跟踪审查，从而不断提升药物警戒体系的效能。
rows.location: 二、持有人开展内审应注意哪些问题 (Q2)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and any time limit; statement adds nothing. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应 = Mandatory, 可以/可 = Permitted, 需要关注 = Recommended).
rows.quote_en: Internal audit shall be based on risk prevention and control, and key pharmacovigilance activities shall be included in the scope of review. For problems found in internal audit, causes must be identified promptly, rectified and followed up through review, so as to continuously improve the effectiveness of the pharmacovigilance system.

f.title: Innovative and improved new drugs: strengthen post-marketing monitoring and signal detection
f.statement: For innovative drugs and improved new drugs, MAHs shall conduct pharmacovigilance activities in line with the GVP and in particular need to pay attention to: strengthening post-marketing monitoring according to the product's safety profile; raising awareness of suspected ADR reporting among medical institutions, manufacturers, distributors and patients; and increasing the frequency of signal detection for newly marketed products.
f.clause: 三、《规范》对创新药和改良型新药有何特殊的要求 (Q3)
f.applicability: Innovative drugs and improved new drugs (创新药和改良型新药), China

rows.quote: 对于创新药和改良型新药，持有人应当根据《规范》要求开展药物警戒活动。针对创新药和改良型新药，持有人尤其需要关注：根据品种的安全性特征加强药品上市后监测，强化医疗机构、药品生产企业、药品经营企业和患者对疑似药品不良反应信息的报告意识；对于新上市的品种增加信号检测频率；
rows.location: 三、《规范》对创新药和改良型新药有何特殊的要求 (Q3)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and any time limit; statement adds nothing. Level Recommended for the 'particularly need to pay attention to' items (需要关注); the lead-in 应当 restates the general GVP duty. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应 = Mandatory, 可以/可 = Permitted, 需要关注 = Recommended).
rows.quote_en: For innovative drugs and improved new drugs, holders shall carry out pharmacovigilance activities according to the GVP requirements. For innovative drugs and improved new drugs, holders particularly need to pay attention to: strengthening post-marketing monitoring according to the product's safety characteristics, and strengthening the awareness of medical institutions, drug manufacturers, drug distributors and patients of reporting suspected ADR information; increasing the frequency of signal detection for newly marketed products;

f.title: Innovative and improved new drugs: submit PSURs yearly until first re-registration, then every 5 years
f.statement: For innovative and improved new drugs, the MAH submits a periodic safety update report every full year from the date the approval certificate is obtained until the first re-registration, and every 5 years thereafter; where the drug regulatory authority or ADR monitoring institution requires otherwise, the MAH shall submit as required.
f.clause: 三、《规范》对创新药和改良型新药有何特殊的要求 (Q3)
f.applicability: Innovative drugs and improved new drugs (创新药和改良型新药), China

rows.deadline: Every full year from approval until first re-registration; then every 5 years
rows.quote: 自取得批准证明文件之日起每满1年提交一次定期安全性更新报告，直至首次再注册，之后每5年报告一次，药品监督管理部门或药品不良反应监测机构另有要求的，应当按照要求提交。

Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应 = Mandatory, 可以/可 = Permitted, 需要关注 = Recommended).
rows.quote_en: From the date the approval certificate is obtained, submit a periodic safety update report every full year until the first re-registration, and thereafter report once every 5 years; where the drug regulatory authority or ADR monitoring institution has other requirements, the report shall be submitted as required.

f.title: Report foreign suspensions or withdrawals for ADR reasons within 24 hours
f.statement: For drugs marketed both in China and abroad, where a foreign drug regulatory authority requires suspension of sale or use, or withdrawal, because of adverse reactions, the MAH shall report in writing to the national drug regulatory authority and the ADR monitoring institution within 24 hours of becoming aware of the information.
f.clause: 四、因药品不良反应原因被境外药品监督管理部门要求暂停销售、使用或撤市的，持有人应当如何报告 (Q4)
f.applicability: Drugs marketed both in China and abroad

rows.quote: 根据《规范》要求，对于境内外均上市的药品，因不良反应原因被境外药品监督管理部门要求暂停销售、使用或撤市的，持有人应当在获知相关信息后24小时内书面报告国家药品监督管理部门和药品不良反应监测机构。
rows.location: 四、因药品不良反应原因被境外药品监督管理部门要求暂停销售、使用或撤市的，持有人应当如何报告 (Q4)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and any time limit; statement adds nothing. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor; level follows the Chinese modal (应当/应 = Mandatory, 可以/可 = Permitted, 需要关注 = Recommended).
rows.quote_en: According to the GVP, for drugs marketed both in China and abroad, where a foreign drug regulatory authority requires suspension of sale, use or withdrawal from the market for adverse reaction reasons, the holder shall report in writing to the national drug regulatory authority and the ADR monitoring institution within 24 hours after becoming aware of the relevant information.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Foreign suspension of sale/use or withdrawal for ADR reasons

f.title: Intra-group delegation of PV is permitted but legal responsibility stays with the MAH
f.statement: Delegation within a corporate group falls under PV delegation management. The MAH may delegate pharmacovigilance activities to the group headquarters or other group subsidiaries, but the corresponding legal responsibility remains with the MAH.
f.clause: 五、持有人在集团内部委托药物警戒活动应注意什么问题 (Q5)
f.applicability: China; NMPA Center for Drug Reevaluation Q&A on the GVP (药物警戒质量管理规范)

rows.quote: 集团内部委托属于药物警戒委托管理范畴。持有人可以委托集团总公司、集团其他子公司开展药物警戒活动，但相应法律责任仍由持有人承担。
rows.location: 五、持有人在集团内部委托药物警戒活动应注意什么问题 (Q5)

rows.quote_en: Intra-group delegation falls within the scope of pharmacovigilance delegation management. The holder may delegate the group headquarters or other group subsidiaries to carry out pharmacovigilance activities, but the corresponding legal responsibility is still borne by the holder.

f.title: Document intra-group PV delegation in an agreement or written arrangement
f.statement: The MAH and the delegated party may sign a pharmacovigilance delegation agreement or agree in writing on respective responsibilities and working mechanisms, to ensure that information throughout the pharmacovigilance activities is true, accurate, complete and traceable.
f.clause: 五、持有人在集团内部委托药物警戒活动应注意什么问题 (Q5)

rows.quote_en: The holder and the delegated entity may sign a pharmacovigilance delegation agreement, or agree in writing on corresponding responsibilities and working mechanisms, to ensure that information throughout the whole pharmacovigilance process is true, accurate, complete and traceable.

f.title: Assess and regularly audit the delegated party; delegate cooperates with extended inspections
f.statement: The MAH shall assess the delegated party's pharmacovigilance conditions and capability and audit it regularly; the delegated party shall cooperate with the MAH in undergoing extended inspections by the drug regulatory authority.
